name: FileRepository sorting
summary: findAll() must guarantee GLOBAL descending ID order across all collections (merged, not per-collection). FileRepository: merge-sort filenames (order-preserving UUID64 encoding) before per-entity filter/load; still lazy per-entity. Mongo/SQL repos (not yet implemented) would use native sort (ORDER BY id DESC), so contract must be tested via observable findAll() output only, not FileRepository internals.

rawActions.name: Create repository contract test suite
rawActions.summary: Write implementation-agnostic contract suite (runRepositoryContractTests(makeRepo) style) asserting only on findAll() output order (global descending ID across all collections). Only FileRepository plugs in today; suite must not depend on FileRepository internals (filename-sort mechanism) since future Mongo/SQL repos would satisfy the contract via native query-level sort instead. findMany() is in scope: it shares #findAllGenerator with findAll(), so the same ordering contract applies to both.
